snippet.title: Gray Zone Warfare: Winds of War | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
War has come to Lamang. 

The tensions are rising between the three PMC factions. One trigger pull can ignite the conflict and spill all over the Lamang island. It will be up to you to decide whether you join the fight or save your skin. Sooner or later, however, you will feel the Winds of War.

The Winds of War update (0.3) brings major changes to how Gray Zone Warfare plays, introducing large-scale improvements to game flow, exploration, PvP, and player freedom. 

Key features include:
- A realistic weather system with direct gameplay effects
- Combat Outposts (COPs) – 38 forward bases that allow respawning, resupply, and vendor access
- Conflict Zones – dynamic PvP hotspots across the island (Warfare mode onlz)
- New anti-cheat system – reinforcing fair and competitive gameplay
- Over 60 new locations spread across the island for you to explore
- AI improvements with new behaviors, animations, and combat reactions
- 5 new weapons and over 80 attachments, scopes, and optics
- Improved ballistics to boost realism
- New armors, helmets and gear
- T-tags to track and recover lost gear and bait ambushes
- Mortar strikes 
- Repair kits and a reworked gear durability system
- Localization in 11 languages 
- PID - reflective faction armbands to limit friendly fire
- Dragging of comatose teammates
- And plenty more

Check out the complete Changelog: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2479810/view/518588414413504678

See you in Lamang.
Every Move Matters.
